what.text: This page follows refugees from Libya living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6196 Libyan refugees in the United Kingdom, 36.1% of all refugees from Libya.
The United Kingdom is the largest host of Libyan refugees, followed by Germany, France and Malta.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Libya in 2011 and in periods from 2013 to 2020.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Libya from 2015 to 2019.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 84 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
